title: The schools that shaped me.
intro: My journey started at SD Palm Kids Purwokerto and continued at SMP Puhua, where I first grew curious about technology and the digital world. I then chose SMK Telkom Purwokerto, majoring in Software and Game Development (PPLG), where I'm deepening my skills in software development, programming, and digital technology.

items.description: Currently in Grade 12, focusing on software development, programming, and digital technology.
Where I first discovered my passion for technology and the digital world.
Where it all began: my first years of learning, reading, and curiosity.
